title: Abelian inverse-image global sections and set section comparisons
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $F$ an abelian etale sheaf on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Write $F_{set}$ for its underlying set sheaf and $1_X$ for the terminal etale object. For every $f:Y\to X$, there are simultaneous bijections $e_f:\Gamma(Y,f^{-1}F)\simeq(f^{-1}F_{set})(Y\times_X1_X)$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. For every commuting triangle $Z\xrightarrow{h}Y\xrightarrow{f}X$ with $k=hf$, and every $s\in\Gamma(Y,f^{-1}F)$, these satisfy $e_k(\Gamma(\alpha^{-1})(h^*s))=r_{h,f,k}(e_f(s))$, where $\alpha:k^{-1}F\simeq h^{-1}f^{-1}F$ is the canonical composition isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition] and $r$ is the canonical set section comparison [def-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison]. No inverse system, limit, affine, qcqs, torsion, or finite-stage lifting hypothesis or assertion is involved.

source.place: Proposition 7.44.3, clause (2), compatibility with underlying sets and adjunctions; composition via Tags 03CB and 03CC. Read the three tag pages on 2026-10-12; terminal-evaluation compatibility is written by the agent.

proof.text: Use etaleInverseImageAlgebraicStructures, which supplies finite-limit preservation and a natural coefficient isomorphism C_f whose direct-image comparison is identity on sections and whose unit equation intertwines the forgotten abelian unit with the set unit. Its hom-set equation fixes C_f canonically. No inverse-limit or continuity theorem is used.

For T_f the base change of the terminal object and t_f : T_f ≅ terminal the terminal-preservation isomorphism, define e_f as Gamma-to-terminal evaluation, restriction along t_f.hom, then evaluation of C_f at T_f. Each factor is invertible.

Direct images are precomposition and forgetting commutes with them on the nose. The abelian inverse-image composition isomorphism and the chosen set composition isomorphism are determined by the same unit equation. Expand their unit equations, cancel the coefficient isomorphisms, and use naturality along the iterated-pullback pasting isomorphism. Evaluating at the terminal object gives exactly the displayed compatibility with globalSectionsUpperStarMap, Gamma.map of the inverse composition isomorphism, and etaleSetSectionComparison.

proof_origin.place: Clause (2) and composition of inverse images, evaluated at the terminal object; V3 coefficient-comparison reduction.

theorem exists_abelianPullbackGlobalSectionsComparison
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    ∃ e : ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ X),
      ((Sheaf.Γ Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj F)) ≃
      (((Scheme.etaleSetPullback f).obj
        ((sheafForget X.smallEtaleTopology).obj F)).obj.obj
          (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).obj (⊤_ X.Etale)))),
      ∀ (Y Z : Scheme.{u}) (h : Z ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ X) (k : Z ⟶ X)
        (hk : h ≫ f = k)
        (s : (Sheaf.Γ Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
          ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj F)),
        e Z k ((Sheaf.Γ Z.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).map
          ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} h f k hk.symm).inv.app F)
          (globalSectionsUpperStarMap AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} h
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj F) s)) =
        etaleSetSectionComparison h f k hk
          ((sheafForget X.smallEtaleTopology).obj F) (⊤_ X.Etale) (e Y f s)
